extracted.intended_audience: researchers, research administrators and institutions looking for NWO funding programmes (Netherlands)
extracted.subtask_description: Locate and filter research funding programmes offered or listed by NWO (Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research). The page is an index of programmes with faceted filters (status, funding type, discipline, theme) and a paginated list of programme entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter programmes by their current status: Closed, In progress, Upcoming (example counts shown: Closed 47; In progress 406; Upcoming 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this facet to restrict results to programmes that are currently open, ongoing, or already closed; counts next to each status indicate how many programmes match.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing funding types / modalities such as Collaboration with Partners, Curiosity Driven Research, Talent Development, Infrastructure, Applied Science, For specific groups, Interdisciplinary Collaboration, Collaboration with Industry, Societal Partners, International Collaboration, Knowledge Utilisation, Starting Researchers, Diversity, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select one or more funding type(s) to find programmes that match a particular funding modality or target group (e.g., talent development vs. collaboration with industry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing academic disciplines and domains (examples from the page: Archaeology 87; Area studies 117; Art and architecture 104; Astronomy, astrophysics 69; Biology 167; Computer science 167; Economics 201; Law 171; Medicine 113; Physics 125; Sociology 212; Technology 236; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the discipline filter to narrow programmes to subject-area relevance. Counts indicate how many programmes are tagged with each discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theme
rubrics_metrics.description: Facet listing thematic priorities such as Artificial Intelligence 10, Biodiversity 7, Climate 51, Diversity and Inclusion 20, Energy 45, Health 32, Knowledge Utilisation 38, Resilient Society 36, Sustainability 4, Quantum 4, Water 28, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter programmes by strategic or thematic topics to find calls and programmes aligned with particular societal or research themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search results / featured programmes listing
rubrics_metrics.description: The page displays a paginated list of programme entries (total shown: 456 results) with some items marked as featured (examples: Dutch Research Agenda (NWA), Knowledge and Innovation Covenant 2018, NWO Talent Programme 2001, Accelerator - Knowledge and innovation for a competitive logistics sector 2019, etc.). Individual programme entries show title, year, and contextual tags such as 'Part of Mission-driven calls' or 'Part of Thematic Programming'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Browse programme entries to view metadata (title, year, thematic tags). Featured items are highlighted; use pagination controls to access more results. Note: the page may show 'There are no filter options for the current search results' when filters cannot be applied to a given query.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pagination / navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Controls for navigating result pages (Current page indicator, numbered pages, Next/Last links).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use pagination to move through the full set of programme entries; current page and page numbers indicate position within the result set.
